configuration.title: Studium
configuration.repoRoot.description: Path to a prototype-build clone (development mode: lesson-mcp is launched from its sources through tsx). Optional for an installed VSIX: the embedded server dist/lesson-mcp.mjs is used when no clone is found.
configuration.bundlesRoot.description: Directory the lesson-mcp server resolves bundle_ref against (BUNDLES_ROOT). Leave empty to use the repo's own fixtures/ folder.
configuration.bundleRef.description: The bundle to open (relative to bundlesRoot). Defaults to the L1 atomistique demo.
configuration.communityBundlesRoot.descr: Root the 'Community contributions' command discovers approved learner-authored bundles against: the root of all courses, where scene-synth's decide_item path emits <root>/<course>/community/community-<item>.zip. Leave empty to reuse studium.bundlesRoot. The canonical course is never mutated; community items are additive.
configuration.assets.description: Where the webview loads KaTeX/Vega from: 'vendor' (offline, bundled in media/vendor, air-gap safe) or 'cdn' (jsdelivr).
configuration.assets.enum.0: Offline: KaTeX/Vega bundled in media/vendor (air-gap safe).
configuration.telemetryConsent.descripti: Opt in to consented, pseudonymized class telemetry (STUDIUM_TELEMETRY_CONSENT).
configuration.showGraph.description: Open a companion live Learning-Workflow-Graph panel that repaints each turn (typed-graph-lens).
configuration.graphView.description: Graph scope: 'student' (ego-graph around the current frontier) or 'teacher' (the whole graph).
configuration.showMastery.description: Show the live per-concept mastery bar in the lesson pane. OFF by default: it is a teacher/model signal, and showing it to a learner during a quiz can leak the answer (try options, watch which raises mastery). Turn on only for teacher demos.
configuration.modalityPreference.descrip: Modality-adaptive rendering (Ciussi, "comment mieux apprendre si je suis visuel"). Reorders and emphasizes each scene's artifacts toward the learner's preferred modality. Content-preserving: nothing is removed; the non-preferred modality is collapsed, never hidden.
configuration.modalityPreference.enum.0: Lead with the visual modality: 3D orbital / molecule / plot / spectrum renders are ordered first and expanded; equations & text are collapsed (kept, openable).
configuration.modalityPreference.enum.1: Lead with the textual modality: equations, markdown & concise summaries are ordered first and expanded; figures & 3D are collapsed (kept, openable).
configuration.modalityPreference.enum.2: Balanced: the authored order, no extra emphasis (default).
